title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the per-item publish and the draft discard that name no package act on the draft the draft save writes (#23495)
body:
Fixes #23495
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What this does

A draft door that names no package on `/api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME` now acts on one draft: the draft that the draft save naming no package writes (#11087, `resolveWriteHead`). The strict draft read and the draft preview have served that draft since #23291. The per-item publish (`POST …/publish`) and the draft discard (`DELETE …?state=draft`) now take the same address, through one helper, `packagelessDraftAddress` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`. Where the draft save naming no package is refused, both are refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with the `?package=` remedy. The refusal comes from the same builder, `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal`, which gains a `publish` verb. The draft save's receipt now names the package it inherits.

| the item's active rows are bound to | draft save naming no package | strict draft read | publish naming no package (this PR) | discard naming no package (this PR) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| one package `P` | `P`'s draft, else adopts the package-unbound draft into `P` | `P`'s draft, else the package-unbound draft | the same draft, promoted into `P`'s active row | the same draft |
| one package `P`, no draft at that address | creates `P`'s draft | `404 NO_DRAFT` | `404 NO_DRAFT`, naming the other packages' drafts and `?package=` | `200`, `reset: false`; the receipt names the drafts that remain |
| two or more packages | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` | best effort (ADR-0048 §3.3) | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` |
| none (never published into a package) | the package-unbound draft | best effort | the package-unbound draft, else the one package's draft; two packages' drafts: `409` | the same |

Governing text: ADR-0070 TL;DR 1 (the package-less state is no authoring destination); ADR-0048 §3.3 (a context-free read is best-effort); #23165 / PR #23290 (a package-less save or delete addresses the one bound package, refused `409` when ambiguous); ADR-0005, read as the card reads it: the draft read's 404 and the publish's empty slot mean the same thing.

## Measured first: the card's probe, on a real stack

The probe ran on a real stack: better-sqlite3 `:memory:`, the real `ObjectQL`, the real `sys_metadata*` objects, the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, and the real `RestServer` routes. It is the harness of `packages/rest/src/meta-draft-head-package-inheritance.test.ts`. Each door was driven on its own fresh boot, built through the doors. `main` is `23e689dc7`; the fix is `b411a4c54`.

**State 1: active row bound to `P`, drafts `[package-unbound, P]`.** It is reachable through the doors in both arrangements: draft-first then package, or `P`'s draft first. On SQLite, the store's find returns the package-unbound row first in both arrangements.

| door | `main` | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `GET ?state=draft` | `P`'s draft | `P`'s draft |
| `PUT ?mode=draft` | writes `P`'s draft; receipt `(env-wide, state=draft)` | writes `P`'s draft; receipt `(env-wide, package=P, state=draft)` |
| `POST …/publish` | **promotes the package-unbound draft** into a package-unbound active row: active rows `[null, P]` | promotes `P`'s draft into `P`'s row; the package-unbound draft stays |
| `DELETE ?state=draft` | removes `P`'s draft | removes `P`'s draft |

**State 2: active row bound to `P`, the only draft bound to `Q`.** It is reachable through `PUT ?mode=draft&package=Q`.

| door | `main` | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `GET ?state=draft` | `404 NO_DRAFT` | `404 NO_DRAFT` |
| `PUT ?mode=draft` | creates `P`'s draft | creates `P`'s draft |
| `POST …/publish` | **`200`, promotes `Q`'s draft into a `Q` active row**; the item then has two packages, and every package-less save or delete is refused `409` | `404 NO_DRAFT`, naming `Q`'s draft and `?package=`; nothing written |
| `DELETE ?state=draft` | **removes `Q`'s draft** | `200 reset:false`, "… its draft bound to package 'Q' remains"; nothing removed |

The probe also covered the corners around the card's states:

- **The package-unbound draft is the only draft of an item bound to `P`.** On `main`, the publish promoted it into a package-unbound active row beside `P`'s, which no read naming no package serves. This PR promotes it into `P`'s row, as the save adopts it. This state follows directly from state 1 once `P`'s draft is published.
- **Active rows bound to `P` and `Q`, one draft.** The save is refused `409`. On `main`, the publish and the discard acted on that draft. This PR refuses all three with `409`.
- **No active row, drafts `[package-unbound, Q]`.** On `main`, the discard removed `Q`'s draft while the save wrote the package-unbound one. This PR acts on the package-unbound draft.
- **No active row, drafts `[Q]` only.** It is unchanged: both doors act on `Q`'s draft.

The full probe matrix and both runs are in the dev report on #23495.

Each of the three hypotheses was measured against the source and the probe. **H1** held: the `draftKey === undefined` branch read a package-agnostic `findEnvironmentRow`. **H2** held: the discard resolved from `packagelessAddress(…, 'draft')`. **H3** held: the receipt read `(env-wide, state=draft)` with the package inherited.

## The decisions this PR takes, and why

1. **The address is the draft save's**, not the draft rows'. For an item bound to `P`, that is `P`'s draft, else the package-unbound draft. The read, the save, the token and now the publish and the discard all name that one row.
2. **A package-unbound draft of an item bound to `P` is published into `P`.** This mirrors the save's orphan adoption. Promoting it package-unbound minted an active row that no read naming no package serves, which is the defect class #23165 closed for the save. It makes the package-less state an authoring destination, which ADR-0070 TL;DR 1 rules out. #23489's body names this case as this card's. The repository gains `promoteDraft({ adoptInto })`: only an unbound draft row is adopted, a bound one keeps its binding, and the drain removes the draft row by its own key.
3. **No address at `P` gives `404 NO_DRAFT`**, the code and status the strict draft read answers. The publish's sentence names the drafts that remain and the request that reaches them. The discard keeps its `200 reset:false` receipt shape for an address that holds no row.
4. **For an item never published into a package**, both doors act on the package-unbound draft the save writes. If there is none, they act on the one package's draft, the only draft the best-effort read can serve. This keeps a client that drafts a new item with `?package=Q` and publishes naming no package working: `client.meta.publishItem` cannot name a package. Two packages' drafts with no package-unbound one are refused `409` instead of a storage-order pick. This corner is outside the card's two states; see Open questions in the report.
5. **`packageId: null` on the publish (in process only) still pins the package-unbound draft**, as `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema` states. Only the ABSENT key changed meaning.

## Narrowing: requests that answered 200 and no longer do

- A publish or a draft discard naming no package, of an item whose active rows two or more packages hold, is now `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. With no active row and drafts in two or more packages (no package-unbound draft), it is also `409`.
- A publish naming no package, of an item bound to `P` whose only draft is another package's, is now `404 NO_DRAFT`. It used to promote that draft.

Both have their remedy in the request: name the package with `?package=`. The changeset is BREAKING, shipped `minor` under the launch-window convention, carries FROM, TO and the remedy, and its ADR-0087 marker is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. A narrowing owes the seat a contract-tier review before the queue.

## Widening: a request that answered 409 and now answers 200

- A draft discard naming no package, of an item whose active rows are bound to one package `P` while its drafts are bound to two or more packages, was refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`: the address was read off the draft rows, as the published `DeleteMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId` description stated. It now removes `P`'s draft, else the package-unbound draft — the draft the draft save naming no package writes. The same holds for an item never published into a package with a package-unbound draft beside two or more packages' drafts.

Named by the contract review 6190278990 (① item 11). The `domain:engine` seat 1 ruled the line `Clause-②: yes` on it, at `session_01GP3comALHRcRBixS2TEnLF`, and the changeset carries the same declaration and names the former `409` in its FROM block.

## Landing points outside the claimed surface (declared)

The claim's surface is `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, the tests and the changeset. Measurement needed five more files:

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, the same package:
  - the shared refusal's `publish` verb, since the existing builder is reused rather than a second dialect written;
  - `promoteDraft`'s `adoptInto`, because the repository is what writes the promoted active row's binding.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: the `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId` description said an absent key "keeps the historical match any package resolution", which would now be false. The `DeleteMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId` description now states the draft discard's address. These are description-only changes, and `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` was regenerated with `check:generated --fix`.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-draft-head-package-inheritance.test.ts`: the real-stack pins live here, beside #23165's and #22128's.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-publish-package-drafts.test.ts`: an engine double that answered only `findOne` now also answers `find`, which the draft address reads.

## Tests

Every run below is at `c313d36d7`.

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` gains a new `[#23495]` describe with 8 cases over the stub engine:
  - state 1 in both storage orders: the save, read, publish and discard each act on the draft the save writes, and the receipt names `P`;
  - state 2: the publish answers `404 NO_DRAFT` (envelope `code`/`status`), the discard removes nothing, and `?package=Q` reaches the draft;
  - the package-unbound draft promoted into `P`;
  - two packages: `409`, nothing written;
  - an item never published into a package: both orders of `[package-unbound, Q]`, `[Q]` alone, and `[Q, R]` refused `409`.
- `sys-metadata-repository.draft-package-inherit.test.ts` gains 3 `adoptInto` pins, and `meta-draft-head-package-inheritance.test.ts` (rest, real stack) gains 3.
- Two pins of the removed first-row pick were **replaced, not respelled**, each with a comment saying why:
  - `protocol-publish-drafts-package-scope.test.ts` "keeps the historical match-any resolution…" is now the `409`, plus a case pinning that an absent key is not a present `null`;
  - `protocol.org-scoped-write-refused.test.ts` "…consults the lock of the draft row's own package" is now parity with the lock the draft save naming no package is judged by.
- The full `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suite ran in two halves: 236 files passed and 3 skipped; 20563 tests passed and 19 skipped.
- Consumer suites, every file that drives a draft door:
  - objectql: 20 files, 340 tests;
  - rest: 29 files, 1481 tests;
  - runtime: 13 files, 1115 tests.
  All green after the objectql double fix.
- Typecheck exited 0 for `metadata-protocol`, `rest` (with `check:test-typecheck`), `objectql` (with `check:test-typecheck`) and `spec`. `tsc --listFiles` in metadata-protocol includes all 4 edited test files.

**Ablations.** Each ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which landed the mutation on disk and restored the file afterwards with blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. All went red, the expected direction:

1. Draft address ignores the active rows (protocol suite, src-resolved): 6 red: the five `[#23495]` cases over an item with active rows, and the replaced lock pin. The cases for an item never published into a package stayed green, as predicted.
2. `adoptInto` removed in the repository: 2 red, the protocol adoption case and the repository pin.
3. The receipt line deleted: 2 red, both state-1 orders.
4. Ablation 1 on the dist-resolved REST suite:
   - the mutation was rebuilt into `dist/`, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`;
   - 3 of 15 tests went red;
   - restore leg: rebuilt, preflight `--absent` held, the tree was clean, and 15 of 15 passed.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run at `c313d36d7`, derived 113 commands. All 113 ran locally, each exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: 113 derived, 113 accounted for.

- 109 exited 0. They include:
  - `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date;
  - `check:docs`, `check:api-surface` and `check:engine-double-contract`;
  - `check:durability-log-level` and `check:doc-authoring`;
  - `check-adr-0087-registration`, which reads the changeset as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`;
  - `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset`.
- NOT MEASURED, all of them prerequisite refusals in this container rather than findings:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3): a shallow clone, missing its pinned positive control;
  - `check:skill-examples` (exit 3): `client-react` is not built;
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3): the full repo is not built;
  - `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` (exit 2): a shallow clone, refusing a windowed metric.

  CI runs all four.
- `main` moved during the run. A local `merge-tree` against `c7dd48ab4` is clean, with no conflict. Following the seat's instruction, `main` is not merged.

## Acceptance notes

- `#23630 remains open`: the promote doors' D9.9 ownership question shares `promoteDraftForPublish` and is serial behind this PR. Its region is untouched.
- The runtime authoring gate's #9612 package closure still narrows only on a caller-stated package. A publish naming no package that resolves `P` does not narrow to `P`'s closure, while a direct save naming no package does: it resolves `P` before its gates run (#23165). This asymmetry predates this PR and is unchanged here.
- `client.meta.publishItem` has no package option. The remedy for the two narrowed requests, `?package=`, is reachable on the REST door and in process, but not through that SDK method. objectui's `publish()` sends `?package=`; its `publishDraft()` sends none.
- The draft discard's receipt ("Draft discarded — TYPE/NAME") still does not name the package. The card asked only for the save receipt.
- Not touched: `restoreArtifactRegistryView` (#23645, a sibling's) and the neighbouring regions of #23628, #23626, #23504 and #23514.
